headline: Concordia Irvine lead the conference in wins
dek: Concordia Irvine's win over Chaminade on Tuesday was their fifth of the season, more than any other programme in the conference has managed, and their first since conference play opened. Four defeats and one draw stand beside those wins; they have scored nineteen goals and conceded seventeen.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Concordia Irvine's nineteen goals have been shared among twelve different scorers, and none of the twelve appears among the conference's leading scorers.

wire.line: Point Loma's first home defeat of the season came in conference play, to Hawai'i Pacific.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Chaminade have lost all nine matches they have played, scoring five goals and conceding twenty-four.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hawai'i Hilo have conceded eight goals across four wins, one draw and three defeats, and have scored nine.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Twelve matches dated in August still carry no published result, the earliest of them Vanguard's on the season's first day.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hawai'i Pacific have won, drawn and lost three matches each, and have scored eighteen goals and conceded eighteen.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tim Teicher has made twenty-nine saves for Hawai'i Hilo and conceded eight goals, a save percentage of .784.

last_match.line: Concordia Irvine's first win since conference play opened; Chaminade have lost every match they have played.

next_match.line: Hawai'i Pacific are unbeaten in conference play; Concordia Irvine have already lost at home to Hawai'i Hilo.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
